description: Golden dataset for the Repo Advisor chat handler's parse/validation contract. Tests the route's reply/actions parsing against fixed mock responses (no real LLM). Model and grounding quality are out of scope until --real mode.

input.message: I want to migrate a repo from Azure DevOps

cases.mockResponse: {"reply":"Sure — I can open the migration wizard for you.","actions":[{"type":"open_migration_wizard","label":"Open Wizard"}]}

input.message: my migration failed: Cannot parse --above=<n>: unknown unit: "m"

cases.mockResponse: {"reply":"Git LFS isn't installed on the migration server, so the conversion aborted. Install git-lfs and retry.","actions":[]}
cases._note: Exercises the error-KB grounding branch in buildChatPrompt without throwing. The mock reply is fixed, so this validates the parse contract — not model grounding (that needs --real mode).

cases.mockResponse: {"reply":"I can open the migration wizard, create repos, and explain errors."}
cases._note: Model omits actions; the adapter defaults it to [] (Array.isArray check), so actions is still an object/array.

cases.mockResponse: the model hallucinated plain text, not JSON
